notes.title: Meadow Is Getting New Content and a Price Change
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5822143/033ef05c74e4986c8ee9dc27e7955d8fec57a8c3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hello![/h3]

I hope you're all well. I come bearing news about Meadow, our online multiplayer animal roleplaying game [i](mouthful, innit?)[/i], which as you may know is set in the world of Shelter. It’s been a good while since we gave you an update on the game, and as we approach the anniversary we thought we would touch base and let you know what the future for Meadow looks like - at least in broad terms. 

As many of you know we at Might and Delight have recently released Book of Travels to Early Access and rebuilt our team, and so we’ve also been able to allocate more staff and resources to the further development of Meadow. 

Whilst we aren’t ready to go into detail on exactly what we're working on today, we [i]can [/i]confirm that [b]we do indeed have plans for new features, quality of life improvements, stability updates, downloadable content[/b] and more for Meadow. In the coming weeks we will update and reveal the specific details of these plans and what it means for Meadow and the world of Shelter in general.

The development of these new features has already started, as people may have noticed with our first [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/486310/discussions/0/3806153791382993742/]beta release[/url], but as this grows it will affect the overall production cost of Meadow, and so [b]in the future we will raise the price of the game[/b]. This will also put us in a better position to support Meadow long term. We’re expecting this change will be applied in early November, to coincide with new features being released. 

Exciting times ahead, friends! Again, you’ll hear from us again soon - so stay tuned in the meantime. 

[b]Best,
Oliver & the team at Might and Delight 
[/b]

notes.title: An Update on Current Affairs at Might and Delight
notes.content:
[h3]Community members, Travellers, Friends[/h3]

The past months have been the most revolving, intriguing and emotional that we have ever experienced at our studio. Releasing [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1152340/Book_of_Travels/]Book of Travels[/url][/b] in Early Access and trying to keep up with the logistical and emotional aftermath has been both fun and challenging. It's safe to say that this period has been unique for us.

It's in the wake of these events that we reach out to you with some important news. [b]With the ambition to be both transparent and concise,[/b] we want to share the current status of our company to you all. Our goal is always for you, our community, to know who we really are – whatever that may be.

In light of the launch not going quite as well as we had hoped, we have had to make some rather big, and difficult, cutbacks to our beloved team. In order to stay alive, we have been forced to cut down our team from around 35 people to 10 people. Saying goodbye to so many skilled, trusted and loved Might and Delighters has been, without a shadow of a doubt, our most difficult test in our 11 year history.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35811177/68d36d062369cefe5ca712d9a880320ceb6482fe.jpg[/img]

Understandably, many of you will wonder how this is going to affect the studio going forward. We have suffered a setback and as a result the production pace of coming content WILL be affected. We want to be transparent regarding that. However, we also want you to know that the team that remains is determined and hell bent on two things: [b]surviving and bringing the best possible content to the game. [/b]We will do whatever it takes to keep the studio going, and continue to bring it and the company forward together with you.

We want to end by sharing this sentiment; Might and Delight have always been a company that has thrived on the edge and in the margins. We have always sacrificed much in order to bring our visions to life, sometimes going against the smartest strategy in favour of a path closer to our hearts.

We have a donation-like DLC called [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783460/Book_of_Travels__Cup_of_Kindness/]”Cup of Kindness”[/url] [/b]that you can pick up if you wish to further support the project. We also released [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24232/Book_of_Travels_OST_Bundle__The_TMORPG__Soundtrack/]The Book of Travels soundtrack[/url] [/b] and the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/504760/Pid_Soundtrack]Pid Soundtrack[/url][/b] and a brand new [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24250/Might_and_Delight_Complete_Bundle__10_Games__19_DLCs//]Might and Delight bundle with all our 10 games and 19 DLCs[/url][/b], including the two fresh OSTs.

We sincerely hope that this news, grim as it is, reach you well. With hope to continue the journey together.

[b]All the best,
Founders Anders, Jakob & Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: OUT NOW - Shelter 3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/06457db05679546b95102ab752fb50d2b03249cb.png[/img]

[h2]Hello![/h2]
Today is the day that [b]Shelter 3 goes live[/b] and we wanted to reach out to you and let you know about our sale, which comes with an extra 10% discount for those of you who already own a Shelter product. But, sales aside we are also here to share our launch trailer which we think gives the best flavour yet of how it will be to guide those elephants. 
[b]
It will be hard. 
Your path will be treacherous. 
Your babies will need you. [/b]

[previewyoutube=U_IlNFERdzE;full][/previewyoutube]

For a[b] limited 24 hour period[/b] we are also reducing two of our favourite bundles (the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/4733/]M&D bundle[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13317/Shelter_Bundle/]Shelter bundle[/url] - which means that you can get a whole lot of Shelter for less than 70% - including Shelter 3! We’d love to hear all your thoughts on Shelter 3 – it’s definitely something a little different from its predecessors and we’re curious to know what kind of emotions we’ll be reading from you in just a few hours! Of course we’d love to hear your comments and reviews, so please do stay in touch with us right here on Steam or on Facebook or Twitter (buttons below). We’ll be responding as fast as we can throughout the launch period. 

We’ll also be speaking to devs live on our [url=youtube.com/MightAndDelight/]Youtube channel[/url] at around 7pm CET or check out the video if you miss us. 

[b]Thank you from our hearts for being here with us[/b] on this third part of the Shelter journey. We humbly await your reception.
[b]
Best Wishes,

Helen & the Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: New Statues in Meadow
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32963958/2beee0f2bf3c57f13e30ef963fd7f01bb1eb8adb.png[/img]

[h1]Hello!
[/h1]
Following the brilliant turnout for our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/mightanddelight/announcements/detail/2230914753282322228]Meadow birthday party[/url] last month we've been listening to your feedback and made some plans for more statues and achievements. That's right, the fun will go on! Only this time the statues will stay for good, which is just as well because they're not easy to spot!

[h1]Every Month a Creature[/h1]

For each month until the release of Shelter 3 next year, we'll be placing[b] ten statues of an animal from Shelter 3 in the Meadow world. [/b]That's nine more animals altogether and we're going to reveal them one by teasey one as the months roll by ;) As with the anniversary elephants, you'll unlock achievements for the first, fifth and tenth statues you find.
[h1]
Spot the Crocs!
[/h1]
Next you'll be able to hunt low slung crocs across the game world - check them out on podium number two and keep your eyes peeled! We hope you enjoy seeking them out and showing the way and sharing your findings, and best of all, there is absolutely no rush.

We hope you like the crocs! See you in the Meadow!

[b]Best Wishes and stay connected,

Helen and the Shelter Team xx 
[/b]

notes.title: Thank you for Fantastic Anniversary! + New Statue Hunts
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32963958/4eda724f77e08740febf90b174f38c105d3434cb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello![/h1]


A great big thank you to all of you who shared and played our Anniversary Play Event last weekend: we broke our 10k player target and raised a welcome donation for [url=www.safeinourworld.org]Safe in Our World.[/url] We saw lots of you sharing the event on your social channels and some of you helping newbies around the place, and we do appreciate that for a fair few of you the Meadow was a little more crowded than you're used to - so thanks for sharing your space for the party <3 


[h1]Elephants return[/h1]

We're glad you enjoyed helping one another visit them all, and we've heard that many of you don't feel super keen on time limited achievements, so we'll be putting them back for another ten days, which we hope will be enough time for new players to find them all and will allow previous ones to finish up. Expect to see them some time on May 5th. We might add a few extra too, more info on that next week. You'll get achievements for the first, fifth and tenth elephant that you visit.

[h1]More Shelter 3 statues to come...[/h1]

The elephants were so popular that we thought we'd make some more statues for you to find, so in the next couple of months we'll be dropping a different kind of animal in for another ten days. Every animal will be from Shelter 3, and our first new animal will be appearing in June.

We hope this is good news for you and thanks again for a really great super feel good anniversary weekend!

Best Wishes and Stay Safe!

Helen and the Team

notes.title: Free Weekend of Meadow + Charity Play Event for our Tenth Anniversary
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

About this time in April [b]ten years ago, Might and Delight was made,[/b] and to celebrate suitably in these times of lockdown we're holding a great big Meadow play event. For the duration of the play event all profit from our Steam sales will go to charity Safe in Our World, and if we get 10,000 players joining us in #Meadow we'll add 25% to that donation - so please join us, bring your friends along... and help us get to 10,000 players by sharing the event on Twitter and beyond!

ADDITIONAL NEWS! Meadow will be free to play all weekend, so please [url=https://twitter.com/MightAndDelight/status/1252665907400159232]share this news[/url] and invite your friends and family to join in too!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32963958/05cd39ac9dab825c61c1f40cb667807bc4195440.jpg[/img]

[b]
Safe in our World’s mission[/b] is to create and foster worldwide mental health awareness within the video game industry and beyond. Founded by industry veterans in 2019, the charity is currently working to promote positive mental health in the Covid-19 crisis - you can read more about their work [url=www.safeinourworld.org]here.[/url]

The event begins [b]on Thursday April 23rd and will end at midnight on Sunday 25th.[/b] As well as obelisks to unlock together, there will be some special edition statues of elephants to find, which will gain achievements. 

[h1]Details[/h1]
[list]
[*] #PlayApartTogether Event in Meadow
[*] Starts 10 am PST Thursday 23rd April, ends Sunday 26th
[*] All profit from sales of M&D games over the duration go to Safe in Our World
[*] An extra 25% will be added if 10,000 players attend
[*] Spot 10 new hidden elephant statues to unlock achievements and look out for the devs in their special dev skins!
[*] Find your new playmates on [url=https://discord.gg/Yq9C8Yf]Discord[/url] during and after the adventure (#Meadow or #Play-With-The-Devs)
[/list]

[b]Thank you so much for your support through the years - [/b]we're so glad to have had you with us and we look forward to all we can create together in the years to come! 
[b]
Stay safe and be well,

Helen and the team xx[/b]

notes.title: Tobii eyetracking support
notes.content:
Look! Shelter 2 is now available with [url=http://www.tobii.com/xperience/apps/shelter-2/]Tobii eyetracking[/url] support! 
Tune your senses and experience a little more in the dimensions of hunting, caring, and exploring.

Eye tracking features include:
[list]
[*] Infinite screen - Camera movement with eye tracking.
[*] Cub communication - Look at a cub and meow to get a response on how they are feeling.
[*] Hunting vision - Enhanced focus when looking at prey animals.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5822143/04f3c567518f1acfe80e3c476bdedb23a7faf14e.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5822143/c7797181c602e2acb1a3c381758035aa56a3c8ad.png[/img]

There is also a few additions and fixes:
[list]
[*] The skin from the mother in Paws is now available for players who own Paws.
[*] Crouch in hard mode is now togglable.
[*] It is no longer possible to get stuck in menues because of keybinding the pause/escape function to left click.
[/list]

notes.title: Shelter 2
notes.content:
Tomorrow, the 16th of October, is the commercial release of the Steam controller!
We celebrate this with a little patch where we have compatability with the Steam controller and give some long needed care to the controller functionality in Shelter 2.

The patch includes:
[list]
[*]Compability with the Steam Controller.
[*]Default setting for controller input, button for this is located in the input settings menu.
[*]Interface in menues and tutorials now show the conventional key names for (common) controllers.
[*]If you have an empty save file and a controller plugged in, you will now get the controller default mapping automatically.
[/list]
